assumptions.statement: All geometry uses repository provisional boundaries; no official GIS/CAD redline is available.
assumptions.impact: Replace boundaries and recalculate geometry, metrics, figures and drawings.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, setbacks, ownership, road redlines, utilities, fire and heritage controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Zones, envelopes, routes and sections are reversible concepts, not approval controls.

assumptions.statement: Section widths are variables/reference modules, not engineering dimensions.
assumptions.impact: Accessibility, fire, charging, drainage and structure require discipline review.

assumptions.statement: Accessibility, labour, energy, noise and acceptance have no field baseline.
assumptions.impact: No operational outcome is claimed; gates pause or exit on public-interest decline.

assumptions.statement: Four accepted open-source proposals informed representation and governance methods only.
assumptions.impact: No peer name, graphic, text, metric or spatial proposal is reused.

assumptions.statement: Public closed, failed or superseded pull requests are used only to identify submission-process and attribution risks.
assumptions.impact: Unmerged status is not treated as an official design-quality decision, and no rejected proposal content is reused.

assumptions.statement: The four-ledger baseline plan specifies minimum fields, responsible actor and collection windows but contains no observed values.
assumptions.impact: Insufficient samples remain unknown and cannot justify progression from G2 to G3 or G4.
